convert_mat_to_coco_json: convert PoseTrack MAT annotation files into COCO-format JSON for train, val, and test splits
convert_video_frame_ids: rename inconsistent PoseTrack video frame filenames to a consistent zero-padded sequential format
get_video_info: extract the number of frames, width, and height from a video directory of JPEG images
convert_posetrack_kps_to_coco: convert PoseTrack keypoints to COCO keypoint ordering using a computed permutation mapping
gen_annot_structure: generate a COCO-style annotation dictionary with keypoints, bounding box, track ID, and head box
